candidates.reason: Not a resize. The whole portrait layout is shrunk to a postage stamp in the middle of the 728x90 banner, with huge empty side areas. Every line of text is unreadable and the headline and CTA can't be made out.

Best structure of the four: headline on the left, bullets in two columns in the right order, product and CTA on the right. But the logo pill is jammed against the top edge, and the 'Wild honey' bullet is shrunk, indented and smaller than its siblings. The can is tiny inside its circle, and the cropped pink circle in the corner crowds the logo.

Bullets are scattered across the whole banner out of order: 'Garden herbs' is alone at the far left, and 'Wild honey' is tiny at the bottom right. The logo pill is crammed against the CTA as if it were a second button, and the footer copy sits right against them. No grid, no grouping, and the reading order is jumbled.

The headline is strong, and the bullets, can and CTA read left to right. But two bullets ('Garden herbs', 'Wild honey') are shrunk to microscopic text above and below the logo pill at the far left. They are unreadable and out of sequence, and they clutter the brand mark. The can is small and its label is illegible.
